steps.command: python3 -c 'import json,os,subprocess; from pathlib import Path; core=Path('"'"'/work/repos/firstmate'"'"'); tools=Path('"'"'/work/tool-bin'"'"'); tools.mkdir(exist_ok=True); (tools/'"'"'tasks-axi'"'"').symlink_to('"'"'/opt/runtime/tasks-axi/dist/bin/tasks-axi.js'"'"'); env=dict(os.environ,FM_HOME=str(core),PATH=str(tools)+os.pathsep+os.environ['"'"'PATH'"'"']); cap=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['"'"'bash'"'"',str(core/'"'"'bin/fm-tasks-axi.sh'"'"'),'"'"'work'"'"','"'"'capabilities'"'"'],env=env,text=True)); assert cap['"'"'schema'"'"']=='"'"'fm-work-capabilities.v1'"'"' and cap['"'"'contract_major'"'"']==1 and '"'"'set_priority'"'"' in cap['"'"'ops'"'"']; state=core/'"'"'state'"'"'; state.mkdir(exist_ok=True); lock=state/'"'"'.lock'"'"'; lock.write_text('"'"'99999999\n'"'"'); parent=Path('"'"'/work/receipts'"'"'); parent.mkdir(); result=subprocess.run(['"'"'bash'"'"',str(core/'"'"'bin/fm-lock-release.sh'"'"'),'"'"'--authority'"'"','"'"'offline pair endpoint check'"'"','"'"'--receipt'"'"',str(parent/'"'"'outgoing'"'"')],env=env,text=True,capture_output=True); assert result.returncode==1 and '"'"'lock does not belong to the outgoing harness'"'"' in result.stderr,(result.returncode,result.stdout,result.stderr); assert lock.read_text()=='"'"'99999999\n'"'"' and not (parent/'"'"'outgoing'"'"').exists(); lock.unlink(); print(json.dumps(dict(work_contract_major=1,real_lock_release_refuses_unowned_lock=True,lock_preserved=True)))'
